sentences.s: Our classroom is bright and clean.
sentences.sCn: 我们的教室既明亮又干净。

sentences.s: The teacher writes on the blackboard.
sentences.sCn: 老师在黑板上写字。

sentences.s: Turn off the light when leaving.
sentences.sCn: 离开时请关掉电灯。

sentences.s: Please close the door gently.
sentences.sCn: 请轻轻关上门。

sentences.s: Look out of the window at the garden.
sentences.sCn: 看看窗外的花园。

sentences.s: Put your books neatly on the desk.
sentences.sCn: 把书本整齐地放在桌子上。

sentences.s: Please sit down on your chair.
sentences.sCn: 请在你的椅子上坐好。

sentences.s: We learn English on the computer.
sentences.sCn: 我们在电脑上学习英语。

sentences.s: Children play football on the playground.
sentences.sCn: 孩子们在操场上踢足球。

sentences.s: Keep quiet in the library.
sentences.sCn: 在图书馆里请保持安静。

sentences.s: It is a sunny day today.
sentences.sCn: 今天是个晴朗的大晴天。

sentences.s: It is windy, fly kites in the park.
sentences.sCn: 起风了，去公园放风筝吧。

sentences.s: The sky is gray and cloudy.
sentences.sCn: 天空灰蒙蒙的，多云。

sentences.s: Take an umbrella on a rainy day.
sentences.sCn: 下雨天记得带上一把伞。

sentences.s: We make a big snowman on a snowy day.
sentences.sCn: 下雪天我们堆了一个大雪人。

sentences.s: Spring is warm and flowers blossom.
sentences.sCn: 春天暖和，百花盛开。

sentences.s: Put on a thick coat, it is cold.
sentences.sCn: 穿上一件厚外套，外面很冷。

sentences.s: Summer is hot, we eat ice cream.
sentences.sCn: 夏天很热，我们吃冰淇淋。

sentences.s: My blue jacket has warm pockets.
sentences.sCn: 我的蓝色夹克有暖和的口袋。

sentences.s: Dad wears a clean white shirt.
sentences.sCn: 爸爸穿着一件干净的白衬衫。

sentences.s: The girl has a pretty pink dress.
sentences.sCn: 女孩有一条漂亮的粉色连衣裙。

sentences.s: She wears a green skirt for dance.
sentences.sCn: 她穿着一条绿色的裙子去跳舞。

sentences.s: These sports pants are comfortable.
sentences.sCn: 这条运动裤穿起来很舒服。

sentences.s: Tie your shoes before running.
sentences.sCn: 跑步前系好你的鞋带。

sentences.s: Fresh tomatoes are sweet and sour.
sentences.sCn: 新鲜西红柿酸酸甜甜的。

sentences.s: Children love crispy potato chips.
sentences.sCn: 小朋友们喜欢香脆的土豆片。

sentences.s: Carrots are healthy for your eyes.
sentences.sCn: 胡萝卜对眼睛非常有益。

sentences.s: White sheep eat green grass on the hill.
sentences.sCn: 白色的小绵羊在山坡上吃青草。

sentences.s: The brave horse runs very fast.
sentences.sCn: 勇敢的小马跑得飞快。

sentences.s: The gentle cow gives us sweet milk.
sentences.sCn: 温顺的奶牛给我们香甜的牛奶。
